# argent-lens: propose design variants, let the human pick on device

Honest caveats: gated behind the `argent-lens` feature flag (off by default — run `argent enable argent-lens` first, else the tools come back not-found); only one variant can be on screen at a time, so variants must be built, screenshotted and reverted in turn; if you can't produce visibly different captures, stop and tell the user instead of staging duplicates. Discovered via skills.sh. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
